title: LessonCard
description: Extended. A reusable lesson derived from traces and approved for reuse. Not a raw trace, raw memory, or generic prompt fragment. The lifecycle_state gates activation: a lesson should pass review before becoming active.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the lesson was created.

lifecycle_state.description: Lifecycle state; activation requires passing through review.

scope.description: Optional reuse scope, e.g. repo, team, org, global.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity level governing how the lesson may be surfaced.

applicability.description: Conditions or tags describing when the lesson applies.

source_refs.description: References to the traces/memory the lesson was derived from (provenance).
